paragraphs: I am writing to apply for the Counsel position at Capital Group. My background in international corporate law and hands-on experience with contract drafting and negotiation aligns perfectly with your need for a Counsel who can design and operationalize AI policies and governance frameworks.

At Poise Legal, I managed the full lifecycle of 5-7 commercial agreements per month while conducting regulatory and company law research to support corporate clients. My legal expertise spans across various areas including contract law, corporate law, and intellectual property principles.

My recent language internship at Asianajajatoimisto Regelin Oy in Oulu allowed me to bridge my international legal expertise with the Finnish legal system. I have developed a strong working proficiency in Finnish and can communicate professionally in both English and Finnish.

Capital Group's commitment to fostering a culture of diversity and belonging resonates with my own values. I am excited about the opportunity to contribute to your Legal & Compliance team and help create policies that empower teams to experiment, deploy, and manage AI responsibly at enterprise scale.
I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how I can contribute to Capital Group's mission.
